headline: Lithium ETF Up Slightly as Albemarle and Chile's SQM Drop Over 2%
summary: The LIT lithium ETF edged up 0.10% to $62.69, even as major producers Albemarle and Chile's Sociedad Química y Minera dropped 2.02% and 2.26%, respectively, in New York trading.
why: Lithium is the critical chemical component in rechargeable electric vehicle batteries; SQM and Albemarle dominate worldwide extraction capacity.
